name: Storm Elemental
primary:
A storm elemental appears in front of you and follows you for 60 s. At most 2 elementals serve you at once: a third one replaces the oldest. It attacks monsters nearby and whoever fights you, and never harms you or your allies.
A small thundercloud that flies next to you and strikes with lightning every 1.3 s from up to 13 blocks. The strike never misses:
• Damage 2.5 ❤ lightning (×2 on wet)
• Charge 30
Immune to lightning.
self_description: The elemental appears right next to you.
